integrity: Analytic full-parametric proof with standalone finite rational reproducibility checker; finite checks are not exhaustive proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only strongly connected one-way cycles with at least three vertices and strictly positive clockwise rates. End-step positivity, not stage positivity. Independent verification not performed; a specialized historical source may contain a logically equivalent statement.
title: A fastest-exit positivity frontier for Crank–Nicolson on directed cycles
